fields.label: Authentication type
fields.description: Choose the type of authentication to Azure services

help.markdown:
Discriminated-union object written by the `@grafana/azure-sdk` `AzureCredentialsForm`. Shape depends on `authType`:

- `msi` — `{ authType: 'msi' }`
- `workloadidentity` — `{ authType: 'workloadidentity' }`
- `clientsecret` — `{ authType: 'clientsecret', azureCloud, tenantId, clientId }` (secret in `secureJsonData.azureClientSecret`)
- `clientcertificate` — `{ authType: 'clientcertificate', azureCloud, tenantId, clientId, certificateFormat: 'pem' | 'pfx' }` (cert/key/password in `secureJsonData.clientCertificate` / `secureJsonData.privateKey` / `secureJsonData.certificatePassword`)
- `currentuser` — `{ authType: 'currentuser', serviceCredentialsEnabled?: boolean, serviceCredentials?: {authType: 'msi' | 'workloadidentity' | 'clientsecret', ...} }`

fields.label: Enable Basic Logs
fields.description: Enabling this feature incurs Azure Monitor per-query costs on dashboard panels that query tables configured for Basic Logs.

fields.label: Enable Batch API
fields.description: Use the Azure Monitor batch metrics endpoint for multi-resource metric queries. Only takes effect when Grafana has the `azureMonitorBatchAPI` feature toggle enabled.

fields.label: Health Models dataplane URL
fields.description: HTTPS endpoint ending in .data.cloudhealth.azure.com for the experimental Health Models query editor. Configure through provisioning until ARM endpoint discovery is available. Supported in Azure public cloud only.

fields.label: Health Models entity path
fields.description: Entity-health operation path relative to the Health Models dataplane endpoint, including any required API-version query parameter. Configure through provisioning.
Default query interval reported to Grafana. Parsed by the backend into `AzureMonitorSettings`.

fields.label: Timeout
fields.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds

fields.label: Allowed cookies
fields.description: Grafana proxy deletes forwarded cookies by default. Specify cookies by name that should be forwarded to the data source.

fields.label: Enable Secure Socks Proxy
fields.description: Route data source requests through Grafana's Secure Socks Proxy. Rendered by `@grafana/ui`'s `SecureSocksProxySettings`, and only when the Grafana instance has `secureSocksDSProxyEnabled`.

fields.label: Client Secret
fields.description: Client secret of the App Registration. Written write-only by `@grafana/azure-sdk`'s `AzureCredentialsForm`; check `secureJsonFields.azureClientSecret` on the read side. Used when `jsonData.azureCredentials.authType` is `clientsecret`, `clientsecret-obo`, or `currentuser` with a `clientsecret` fallback.

fields.label: Client Certificate
fields.description: Client certificate body (PEM text or base64-encoded PFX depending on `azureCredentials.certificateFormat`). Written by `@grafana/azure-sdk`.

fields.label: Private Key
fields.description: Private key paired with the PEM client certificate. Only used when `azureCredentials.certificateFormat == 'pem'`. Written by `@grafana/azure-sdk`.

fields.label: Certificate Password
fields.description: Password protecting the PFX client certificate bundle. Only used when `azureCredentials.certificateFormat == 'pfx'`. Written by `@grafana/azure-sdk`.

Legacy client secret key. Preserved for backward compatibility with datasources provisioned before the credential migration to `azureClientSecret`. The backend reads it as a fallback when `secureJsonData.azureClientSecret` is missing.

Entra password used only when the backend `azcredentials` builder encounters `authType == 'ad-password'`. The Azure Monitor config editor does not expose this authentication type today; the field is only reachable through provisioning YAML.

Legacy top-level auth-type field written by the pre-2023 Azure Monitor config editor before credentials were nested under `jsonData.azureCredentials`. Read by the backend legacy fallback and by the frontend when no `azureCredentials` object is present. `updateDatasourceCredentials` in `@grafana/azure-sdk` unsets this field whenever the editor saves.

Legacy Azure cloud discriminator (values `azuremonitor` / `chinaazuremonitor` / `govazuremonitor` / `customizedazuremonitor`). Read by the backend's `resolveLegacyCloudName` and by `resolveLegacyCloudName` in `@grafana/azure-sdk`. Also gates `customizedRoutes` — `azureCloud == 'AzureCustomizedCloud'` (derived from `cloudName == 'customizedazuremonitor'`) is the only way the backend consults `jsonData.customizedRoutes`.

Legacy top-level tenant ID (paired with legacy `clientId`/`clientSecret`). Preserved so pre-migration datasources continue to authenticate; the current `AzureCredentialsForm` writes tenant inside `jsonData.azureCredentials.tenantId` and clears this field.

Legacy top-level client ID (paired with legacy `tenantId`/`clientSecret`). Preserved so pre-migration datasources continue to authenticate; the current `AzureCredentialsForm` writes client inside `jsonData.azureCredentials.clientId` and clears this field.

Set to `true` by `@grafana/azure-sdk`'s `updateDatasourceCredentials` whenever the selected auth type is `clientsecret-obo` or `currentuser`. Consumed by Grafana's shared HTTP client to forward the caller's OAuth token.
Set to `true` by `@grafana/azure-sdk`'s `updateDatasourceCredentials` when `currentuser` authentication is selected, to prevent user-scoped results from leaking across users. No editor UI.

Map of route name → `{ URL, Scopes, Headers }` overriding the default Azure Monitor / Log Analytics / Resource Graph endpoints. Only consulted by the backend when the resolved cloud is `AzureCustomizedCloud`. Not rendered by the config editor — configured via provisioning YAML.

instructions.msg: The Azure Monitor datasource authenticates through the discriminated-union object at `jsonData.azureCredentials` written by the `@grafana/azure-sdk` `AzureCredentialsForm`. Supported `authType` values: `clientsecret` (App Registration + Client Secret — always available), `clientcertificate` (App Registration + Client Certificate — always available), `msi` (Managed Identity — only when Grafana has `azure.managedIdentityEnabled`), `workloadidentity` (only when `azure.workloadIdentityEnabled`), `currentuser` (only when `azure.userIdentityEnabled` AND the `azureMonitorEnableUserAuth` feature toggle is on). Two backend-only values also exist for compatibility with the shared azure-sdk builder: `clientsecret-obo` and `ad-password`.
